questions.q: What does Trivy scan, and what does it block on?
options: Terraform code; blocks on any warning
The built container image; blocks on CRITICAL vulnerabilities with a fix available
Commit diffs; blocks on leaked credentials
Helm values files; blocks on missing resource limits
questions.explain: Trivy scans the built container image (product-catalog and checkout) and blocks the pipeline on CRITICAL vulnerabilities that have an available fix.

questions.q: What does Checkov scan in Northbridge's pipelines?
options: The Terraform code in infra/terraform for misconfigured Azure resources
The React frontend bundle size
Docker image layers for CRITICAL CVEs
Kubernetes pod logs for errors
questions.explain: Checkov runs in the IaC pipeline right after terraform plan, scanning infra/terraform for misconfigured resources before apply.

questions.q: Why does gitleaks run both as a pre-commit hook and in CI?
options: Running it twice doubles detection accuracy mathematically
The pre-commit hook is slower, so CI runs a quick version
A developer's machine isn't guaranteed to have the hook installed, so CI is the backstop
Pre-commit only checks Terraform, CI only checks application code
questions.explain: The guide explicitly notes CI is the backstop because the local pre-commit hook isn't guaranteed to be installed on every developer's machine.

questions.q: How does a pod authenticate to Azure Key Vault to receive synced secrets?
options: A stored client secret baked into the container image
A shared password committed to a .env file
Azure AD Workload Identity federation, with no stored client secret
Basic auth over the cluster's internal network
questions.explain: External Secrets Operator authenticates to Key Vault using the same Azure AD Workload Identity federation used elsewhere in the capstone — no stored secret in the cluster.

questions.q: In the near-miss incident, what actually stopped the PaymentPro test key from reaching main?
options: A manual code review caught it before merge
The engineer remembered and deleted it before committing
gitleaks's pre-commit hook flagged it and aborted the commit
Checkov flagged it as a misconfigured resource
questions.explain: gitleaks's pre-commit hook detected the key pattern in charts/checkout/values.yaml and aborted the commit before it reached any branch.
